Exploratory tests of speculative ideas: methods jaxdft does not use and may
never use, tried on small model problems to see whether they deserve more
work. Like the concept posts, these implement everything themselves in
NumPy/SciPy, with the code shown, and that code is untested. A result here is
a reason to look further, not a validated method; nothing reaches jaxdft
without going through a milestone.
